title: Wrong Answer Buzzer
blurb: The game-show buzzer that means no, absolutely not, thanks for playing. Decades of television trained audiences to feel this sound in the chest before the brain catches up — it's a harsh low buzz engineered to be unpleasant, because humiliation was always part of the format. Deploy it for quiz nights, group chats, and the exact moment someone says "trust me" before being catastrophically wrong. Play it out loud during an argument and the argument is over; there is no appeal process. Free MP3 for edits, streams, and classroom revision games.
origin: Modeled on the classic Family Feud-style rejection buzzer.
